title: The Reward Model Selection Crisis in Personalized Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2512.23067v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Personalized alignment from preference data has focused primarily on improving personal reward model (RM) accuracy, with the implicit assumption that better preference ranking translates to better personalized behavior. However, in deployment, computational constraints necessitate inference-time adaptation such as reward-guided decoding (RGD) rather than per-user policy fine-tuning. This creates a critical but overlooked requirement: reward models must not only rank preferences accurately but also effectively guide generation. We demonstrate that standard RM accuracy fails catastrophically as a selection criterion for deployment-ready personalized rewards. We introduce policy accuracy; a metric quantifying whether RGD-adapted LLMs correctly discriminate between preferred and dispreferred responses and show that upstream RM accuracy correlates only weakly with downstream policy accuracy (Kendall's tau = 0.08--0.31). translated_abstract: 基于偏好数据的个性化对齐研究主要集中于提升个人奖励模型（RM）的准确性，其隐含假设是更好的偏好排序能力会转化为更好的个性化行为。然而在实际部署中，计算资源的限制使得必须采用推理时自适应方法（如奖励引导解码，RGD），而非针对每个用户进行策略微调。这就产生了一个关键但长期被忽视的需求：奖励模型不仅要能准确排序偏好，还必须能够有效引导文本生成。我们证明，标准的RM准确性作为面向部署的个性化奖励模型的选拔标准会遭遇灾难性失效。我们提出了“策略准确性”这一新指标，用于量化经过RGD自适应的大语言模型能否正确区分偏好响应与不偏好响应，并发现上游RM准确性与下游策略准确性之间仅有微弱的相关性（Kendall's tau = 0.08–0.31）。更关键的是，w
tldr: 该论文揭示传统的奖励模型准确性指标无法预测其在奖励引导解码中的实际表现，并提出“策略准确性”新指标，指出上游奖励模型准确性与下游策略准确性仅有微弱相关性（Kendall's tau = 0.08–0.31）。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that standard reward model accuracy fails catastrophically as a selection criterion for deployment-ready personalized rewards, and introduces "policy accuracy," showing only weak correlation (Kendall's tau = 0.08–0.31) between upstream RM accuracy and downstream policy accuracy.
